description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Walpita, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District (24/1203)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations, property ownership determinations, and land parcel allocations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, encumbrances, and specific land-related legal determinations by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
